item.tib: rtse drug gnas kyis yon tan lo rgyus gsal ba'i sgron me pad 'byung nam mkha' rin chen gyi bsnyan rgyud
item.coloph: bla ma rig 'dzin mkha' 'gro'i bka' lung / khyad par gnas kyi yin tshul gyis (gyi) lo rgyus gsal ba'i sgron me 'di/ phyi rabs yid ches bskyed pa'i phyir/ 'gru btsun shes rab rgyal mtshan gyis/ yang yang bskul ma byas nas su/ dkar chag yi ger btab pa 'di/ mkha' 'gro'i tshogs la bzod par gsol/ 'di bris dge ba'i rtsa ba des/ phyi rabs rjes 'bring gang zag rnams/ gnas kyi yon tan rab rdzogs nas/ mchog thun dngos grub bsnyem par shog sprul sku nam mkha' rin chen gyi drung du zhus pa lags so//
